entry.title: AGI Consensus Board: What Forecasters Put on AGI by 2027–2040
entry.summary: Snapshot 2026-09-26: median across 2 forecasting series on 'AGI before 2027/2028/2030/2035/2040' — before 2027: 8% (spread 11%); before 2028: 45% (spread 42%); before 2030: 64% (spread 29%) — with spread, each series' resolution basis and a published recompute formula. No bets, no affiliate links.

entry.title: AGI Scorecard Data for AI Agents: JSON, Feed, llms.txt
entry.summary: Free, machine-readable AGI verdict data: /data.json (CC BY 4.0), an Atom feed, and llms.txt. Copy-paste prompt to add verdict-change alerts to any AI agent.

entry.title: 预言 AGI 2027 的基金，7 月爆仓了 | AGI 记分牌
entry.summary: 他预言 AGI 2027、两年回报超1000%、做空英伟达85亿——2026年7月单月亏约67%，公开股票组合大部分转让给 Citadel。完整仓位收据与时间线，基于公开文件与多家媒体报道。

entry.title: How Are Top Investors Positioned on AI? (Q2 2026 13F)
entry.summary: Eight investing legends, graded from line-by-line Q2 2026 13F filings: 3 bull, 4 cautious, 1 bear. Filed August 14. Plus Aschenbrenner's own blown-up fund.

entry.title: Is AI music good enough yet?
entry.summary: 97% of 9,000 blind-test listeners could not tell AI music from human. It is over half of Deezer's daily uploads and 1-3% of actual listening.

entry.title: EU AI Act: What Applies Now vs. What Got Deferred (2026)
entry.summary: As of Aug 2026: chatbot disclosure applies (no grace period); the Digital Omnibus deferred high-risk duties to Dec 2027/Aug 2028. The dated ledger.

entry.title: AGI Timeline: Prediction Markets vs Evidence
entry.summary: Polymarket's AGI-by-2027 contract vs the evidence: the market prices an announcement, the scorecard grades capability (62.5/100). Issue #4 of a running comparison.

entry.title: AGI Questions, Answered — The Full Scorecard Index
entry.summary: Every question the AGI Scorecard answers: was Aschenbrenner right, when will AGI arrive, is AGI hype, forecaster comparisons.

entry.title: Does Amodei's AI slowdown change the 2027 AGI odds?
entry.summary: Amodei asked the industry to pace the frontier on Sept 12, 2026. Graded against the eight predictions: no verdict moved — and what would move one.

entry.title: Aschenbrenner vs Metaculus: AGI Timeline Comparison (2026)
entry.summary: Aschenbrenner predicts AGI by 2027; the Metaculus community median is 50% by 2033. A side-by-side of how the two forecasts differ and why — updated mid-2026.

entry.title: When Will AGI Arrive? Every Major Forecast Compared (2026)
entry.summary: Public AGI forecasts now cluster between 2026 and 2047: Musk 2026, Aschenbrenner 2027, Hassabis ~2030, Metaculus 2033, academic surveys 2047.

entry.title: Can AI Replace Knowledge Workers? The 2025/26 Call, Graded
entry.summary: Aschenbrenner predicted frontier AI would outpace college graduates on knowledge work by 2025/26.

entry.title: Should You Worry About AI Taking Your Job? (Sep 2026)
entry.summary: A dated verdict: fear (79%) vs the economy-wide record (4.2% unemployment, no discernible disruption) vs one real early signal: ages 22–25 in exposed jobs.

entry.title: Was Amodei Right About the White-Collar Bloodbath? (2026)
entry.summary: Dario Amodei's May 2025 call: half of entry-level white-collar jobs gone, 10–20% unemployment, in 1–5 years. Graded against the data as of Sept 2026.

entry.title: Will AI Cause Mass Unemployment? What the Data Shows (2026)
entry.summary: Not the overnight jobs cliff the headlines predict. AI has crossed capability thresholds (~83% GDPval) but reliable unsupervised job replacement is undemonstrated.

entry.title: Will AI Take Over? What the Capability Data Says (2026)
entry.summary: Every takeover scenario presupposes reliable autonomous agency — which doesn't exist yet. AI is a powerful assistant (~83% GDPval) that can't run one job unsupervised. A sober read.

entry.title: What Jobs Are Safe From AI? The Autonomy-Gap Answer (2026)
entry.summary: The safest work needs reliable, unsupervised, end-to-end judgment — the exact thing AI still lacks. Why 'safe' is about autonomy, not intelligence, and how to watch it change.

entry.title: Will AI Replace Programmers? What Benchmarks Say
entry.summary: Partly, and unevenly. Agentic coding is strong (~80% on SWE-Bench Pro) and agents ship real code.

entry.title: AI vs Human Intelligence: Who's Ahead in 2026?
entry.summary: Superhuman in narrow bands, subhuman where it counts — reliable autonomous judgment. Intelligence is a jagged frontier, not one scale. Where AI leads and humans still win.

entry.title: What Is GDPval? The AI Knowledge-Work Benchmark, Explained
entry.summary: GDPval is a benchmark that scores AI on real, economically valuable knowledge-work tasks across many occupations. Top models now reach ~83% — the evidence behind the On-track 'AI outpaces knowledge workers' verdict.
